role: The lightning bolt weather entity: the constructor ignites fire around the strike point, onUpdate runs the flash state machine, re-ignites fire and damages every entity in a 3-block box, and on the client it sets World.lastLightningBolt for the sky flash and feeds the bolt render.
scope_reason: Lightning is not on world.conf's switched-off list; the whole-server storm recording world-storm-s1 and the lightning oracle recordings cover it.

members.name: EntityLightningBolt
members.note: server: the constructor's draws and fire. The client constructor (a Random and a UUID from the CLIENT seeder, boltVertex, boltLivingTime) is clientstate_bolt_spawn

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: server: lightning_tick, with the two sound pitch draws (ambient.weather.thunder, random.explode) spent where Java spends them; the sounds themselves are client audio. The client branch (lastLightningBolt = 2 while lightningState >= 0, the same draws, no fire) is clientstate.c clientstate_weather_tick, checked bolt for bolt on cs_storm. A bolt that hurts the player (serverreplay.c serverreplay_lightning_strike's player branch) sends the tracker pass's S1C of the new health and wakes a sleeper, bed-wake-s1

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: Empty override; bolts live in World.weatherEffects and are never persisted.

members.name: lightningState
members.note: Mirrored as lightning_bolt.state, set to 2 by lightning_adopt and driven by lightning_tick.

members.name: boltVertex
members.note: Drawn with jr_long at the servertick thunder spawn and carried on the spawn record; also lightning_bolt.vertex in csrc/engine/lightning.h. Only consumer would be the client bolt render, which is not ported.

members.name: boltLivingTime
members.note: Drawn with jr_int_n(r, 3) + 1 at the servertick thunder spawn; mirrored as lightning_bolt.living_time.

members.name: __OBFID
members.note: Compiler-injected obfuscation constant (groups the file's static constants).

notes: Server-side path is proven: csrc/tests/test_lightning.c compares 6 bolts over 30 ticks across four scenes (state, living_time, Random state, fire mask, target hp/fire, pigman conversion, Det state) against out/java/lightning/light2, light42, light2-no-fire and light2-easy (six strike scenes each per DEVLOG 2026-09-24). out/java/snapshots/world-storm-s1 is a whole-server storm recording the replay passes with 0 field mismatches (DEVLOG lines ~1161-1170). Not verified: whether any native client replay sets lbolt on bolt spawn (grep found lbolt only in renderstate.c and test_renderstate.c), and the exact AABB iteration order claim in serverreplay.c's comment (spawn order until a chunk crossing) beyond what the tests assert. The client bolts and lastLightningBolt: clientstate.c, stepped against every cs_storm row (a bolt built from the tick-start CLIENT seeder, a natural one already in flight), and play.c builds one for each bolt the server spawned. lane/idxentity: the playSoundEffect calls are audio; their Random draws are ported, so nothing in-scope is missing.
